ucs.title: [LLM] MuddyWater (Mango Sandstorm / Static Kitten) RMM tool deployment via phishing lure
ucs.description: Hunts MuddyWater's signature post-phishing pivot: dropping a legitimate Remote Monitoring & Management agent (Atera, ScreenConnect, RemoteUtilities, SimpleHelp, Syncro, SplashTop) as the initial foothold instead of custom malware. The chain is Office/browser/archive parent → RMM installer/agent child in a user-writable path — exactly the technique Microsoft, ClearSky and Group-IB attribute to Mango Sandstorm / TA450 campaigns against Middle-East government, telco and energy targets.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.process_path) as image values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_cmd from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("AteraAgent.exe","atera.exe","ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe","ConnectWiseControl.Client.exe","RemoteUtilities.exe","rutserv.exe","rfusclient.exe","SimpleHelp.exe","Syncro.exe","SyncroService.exe","AnyDesk.exe","splashtop.exe","Splashtop-streamer.exe") (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe","msiexec.exe","explorer.exe","WinRAR.exe","7zG.exe","7zFM.exe","chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","OneDrive.exe") OR Processes.process_path="*\\Users\\Public\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\Downloads\\*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | search NOT user="*$" | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let RmmBinaries = dynamic(["ateraagent.exe","atera.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe","connectwisecontrol.client.exe","remoteutilities.exe","rutserv.exe","rfusclient.exe","simplehelp.exe","syncro.exe","syncroservice.exe","anydesk.exe","splashtop.exe","splashtop-streamer.exe"]);
let SuspiciousParents = dynamic(["winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe","msiexec.exe","explorer.exe","winrar.exe","7zg.exe","7zfm.exe","chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","onedrive.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where FileName in~ (RmmBinaries)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (SuspiciousParents)
    or FolderPath has_any (@"\Users\Public\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\Downloads\", @"\ProgramData\")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256, InitiatingProcessAccountUpn
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let RmmBinaries = dynamic(["ateraagent.exe","atera.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe","connectwisecontrol.client.exe","remoteutilities.exe","rutserv.exe","rfusclient.exe","simplehelp.exe","syncro.exe","syncroservice.exe","anydesk.exe","splashtop.exe","splashtop-streamer.exe"]);
let SuspiciousParents = dynamic(["winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe","msiexec.exe","explorer.exe","winrar.exe","7zg.exe","7zfm.exe","chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","onedrive.exe"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ChildBin  = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, '\\')[-1])),
         ParentBin = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, '\\')[-1]))
| where ChildBin in (RmmBinaries)
| where ParentBin in (SuspiciousParents)
    or NewProcessName has_any (@"\Users\Public\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\Downloads\", @"\ProgramData\")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where SubjectUserName !in~ ("SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, TargetUserName,
          ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, LogonId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: MuddyWater RMM Tool Deployment via Office/Browser/Archive Parent
id: 0c8a2f4b-9e1d-4a3c-91f5-muddywater-rmm-2024
status: experimental
description: Detects MuddyWater (Mango Sandstorm / Static Kitten / TA450) post-phishing RMM-as-implant pattern — Atera, ScreenConnect, RemoteUtilities, SimpleHelp, Syncro, AnyDesk or SplashTop spawned by an Office, browser, archive or Outlook parent, or running from a user-writable path.
references:
  - https://www.microsoft.com/security/blog/2023/04/18/mango-sandstorm/
  - https://www.group-ib.com/blog/muddywater-infrastructure/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0069/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2024/01/15
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  child_rmm:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\AteraAgent.exe'
      - '\atera.exe'
      - '\ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe'
      - '\ConnectWiseControl.Client.exe'
      - '\RemoteUtilities.exe'
      - '\rutserv.exe'
      - '\rfusclient.exe'
      - '\SimpleHelp.exe'
      - '\Syncro.exe'
      - '\SyncroService.exe'
      - '\AnyDesk.exe'
      - '\splashtop.exe'
      - '\Splashtop-streamer.exe'
  parent_lure:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\winword.exe'
      - '\excel.exe'
      - '\powerpnt.exe'
      - '\outlook.exe'
      - '\msiexec.exe'
      - '\explorer.exe'
      - '\WinRAR.exe'
      - '\7zG.exe'
      - '\7zFM.exe'
      - '\chrome.exe'
      - '\msedge.exe'
      - '\firefox.exe'
  user_writable_path:
    Image|contains:
      - '\Users\Public\'
      - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
      - '\Downloads\'
      - '\ProgramData\'
  condition: child_rmm and (parent_lure or user_writable_path)
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate IT pushing RMM client via Group Policy or sanctioned ticketed engagement (correlate with change-management records).
  - Vendor support engagement initiated by helpdesk.
level: high
tags:
  - attack.command_and_control
  - attack.t1219
  - attack.t1219.002
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.g0069
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\winword.exe OR *\\WINWORD.EXE OR *\\excel.exe OR *\\EXCEL.EXE OR *\\powerpnt.exe OR *\\POWERPNT.EXE OR *\\outlook.exe OR *\\OUTLOOK.EXE OR *\\msiexec.exe OR *\\MsiExec.exe OR *\\explorer.exe OR *\\chrome.exe OR *\\msedge.exe OR *\\firefox.exe OR *\\WinRAR.exe OR *\\7zG.exe OR *\\7zFM.exe) @Image:(*\\AteraAgent.exe OR *\\ateraagent.exe OR *\\ATERAAGENT.EXE OR *\\ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe OR *\\screenconnect.clientservice.exe OR *\\ConnectWiseControl.Client.exe OR *\\connectwisecontrol.client.exe OR *\\RemoteUtilities.exe OR *\\remoteutilities.exe OR *\\rutserv.exe OR *\\RUTServ.exe OR *\\rfusclient.exe OR *\\RfUsClient.exe OR *\\SimpleHelp.exe OR *\\simplehelp.exe OR *\\Syncro.exe OR *\\SyncroService.exe OR *\\AnyDesk.exe OR *\\anydesk.exe OR *\\splashtop.exe OR *\\Splashtop-streamer.exe) -@User:(*$ OR SYSTEM OR "LOCAL SERVICE" OR "NETWORK SERVICE")
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/^(winword|excel|powerpnt|outlook|msiexec|explorer|chrome|msedge|firefox|winrar|7zg|7zfm|onedrive)\.exe$/i

ucs.title: [LLM] MuddyWater Office-spawned obfuscated PowerShell — POWERSTATS / MuddyC2Go staging
ucs.description: Hunts MuddyWater's long-running POWERSTATS / MuddyC2Go staging pattern: a maldoc opens, the Office app spawns powershell.exe (or mshta/rundll32) with -EncodedCommand / -nop / hidden window flags, base64 blobs, or DownloadString/IEX, and the resulting process beacons to attacker infrastructure. This chain has been documented across MuddyWater operations from POWERSTATS v1 (2017) through MuddyC2Go (2023-2024) and is the most consistent signature of this actor's tradecraft.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.process_path) as image values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_cmd from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe","visio.exe","mspub.exe") Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","cmstp.exe") (Processes.process="*-EncodedCommand*" OR Processes.process="* -enc *" OR Processes.process="* -ec *" OR Processes.process="* -e *" OR Processes.process="*FromBase64String*" OR Processes.process="*DownloadString*" OR Processes.process="*Invoke-Expression*" OR Processes.process="*IEX(*" OR Processes.process="*-WindowStyle Hidden*" OR Processes.process="*-W Hidden*" OR Processes.process="*-NoProfile*" OR Processes.process="*-nop*" OR Processes.process="*-ExecutionPolicy Bypass*" OR Processes.process="*-ep bypass*" OR Processes.process="*javascript:*" OR Processes.process="*vbscript:*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | search NOT user="*$" | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let OfficeParents = dynamic(["winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe","visio.exe","mspub.exe"]);
let ProxyChildren = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","cmstp.exe"]);
let ObfTokens = dynamic(["-EncodedCommand","-enc ","-EC ","-e ","FromBase64String","DownloadString","Invoke-Expression","IEX(","-WindowStyle Hidden","-W Hidden","-NoProfile","-nop","-ExecutionPolicy Bypass","-ep bypass","javascript:","vbscript:","-WindowStyle 1"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (OfficeParents)
| where FileName in~ (ProxyChildren)
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (ObfTokens)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend B64 = extract(@"(?i)(?:-(?:e(?:nc(?:odedcommand)?)?))\s+([A-Za-z0-9+/=]{20,})", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| extend Decoded = iff(isnotempty(B64), base64_decode_tostring(B64), "")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          B64, Decoded, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let OfficeParents = dynamic(["winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe","visio.exe","mspub.exe"]);
let ProxyChildren = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","cmstp.exe"]);
let ObfTokens = dynamic(["-EncodedCommand","-enc ","-EC ","-e ","FromBase64String","DownloadString","Invoke-Expression","IEX(","-WindowStyle Hidden","-W Hidden","-NoProfile","-nop","-ExecutionPolicy Bypass","-ep bypass","javascript:","vbscript:"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ChildBin  = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, '\\')[-1])),
         ParentBin = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, '\\')[-1]))
| where ParentBin in (OfficeParents)
| where ChildBin  in (ProxyChildren)
| where CommandLine has_any (ObfTokens)
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| extend B64 = extract(@"(?i)(?:-(?:e(?:nc(?:odedcommand)?)?))\s+([A-Za-z0-9+/=]{20,})", 1, CommandLine)
| extend Decoded = iff(isnotempty(B64), base64_decode_tostring(B64), "")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName,
          NewProcessName, CommandLine, B64, Decoded
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: MuddyWater Office-Spawned Obfuscated PowerShell / Script Proxy
id: 5a8c1d2e-7f3b-49a0-b8e1-muddywater-powerstats-2024
status: experimental
description: Detects MuddyWater (G0069) POWERSTATS / MuddyC2Go staging — an Office application spawning PowerShell, mshta, wscript, cscript, rundll32 or regsvr32 with obfuscation indicators (EncodedCommand, FromBase64String, DownloadString, IEX, hidden window, bypass execution-policy).
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0069/
  - https://research.checkpoint.com/2023/muddywater-muddyc2go/
  - https://www.deepinstinct.com/blog/muddywater-powerstats
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2024/01/15
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  parent_office:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\winword.exe'
      - '\excel.exe'
      - '\powerpnt.exe'
      - '\outlook.exe'
      - '\visio.exe'
      - '\mspub.exe'
  child_proxy:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\cmstp.exe'
  obfuscation_tokens:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '-EncodedCommand'
      - ' -enc '
      - ' -ec '
      - 'FromBase64String'
      - 'DownloadString'
      - 'Invoke-Expression'
      - 'IEX('
      - '-WindowStyle Hidden'
      - '-W Hidden'
      - '-NoProfile'
      - '-nop'
      - '-ExecutionPolicy Bypass'
      - '-ep bypass'
      - 'javascript:'
      - 'vbscript:'
  condition: parent_office and child_proxy and obfuscation_tokens
falsepositives:
  - Sanctioned Office add-in macros that legitimately invoke PowerShell (rare; investigate).
  - Macro-based corporate automation that has not been refactored to a signed task.
level: high
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1027.010
  - attack.t1218.005
  - attack.t1218.011
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.g0069
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\winword.exe OR *\\WINWORD.EXE OR *\\excel.exe OR *\\EXCEL.EXE OR *\\powerpnt.exe OR *\\POWERPNT.EXE OR *\\outlook.exe OR *\\OUTLOOK.EXE OR *\\visio.exe OR *\\VISIO.EXE OR *\\mspub.exe) @Image:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\cmd.exe OR *\\CMD.EXE OR *\\mshta.exe OR *\\MSHTA.EXE OR *\\wscript.exe OR *\\WScript.exe OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\CScript.exe OR *\\rundll32.exe OR *\\RunDLL32.exe OR *\\regsvr32.exe OR *\\RegSvr32.exe OR *\\cmstp.exe) @CommandLine:(*-EncodedCommand* OR *\ -enc\ * OR *\ -ec\ * OR *FromBase64String* OR *DownloadString* OR *Invoke-Expression* OR *IEX\(* OR *-WindowStyle\ Hidden* OR *-W\ Hidden* OR *-NoProfile* OR *-nop* OR *-ExecutionPolicy\ Bypass* OR *-ep\ bypass* OR *javascript\:* OR *vbscript\:*) -@User:(*$ OR SYSTEM)

#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/^(winword|excel|powerpnt|outlook|visio|mspub)\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh|cmd|mshta|wscript|cscript|rundll32|regsvr32|cmstp)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(-EncodedCommand|\\s-enc\\s|\\s-ec\\s|\\s-e\\s|FromBase64String|DownloadString|Invoke-Expression|IEX\\(|-WindowStyle\\s+Hidden|-W\\s+Hidden|-NoProfile|-nop|-ExecutionPolicy\\s+Bypass|-ep\\s+bypass|javascript:|vbscript:)", field=CommandLine)
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
